fields.statement: QA by hand with the binary built at 668f5cf08, in a scratch repo (bare origin, fake gh reporting PR #7 green): change set Ship it set first's statement, ship check passed, then change set Other rewrote first's statement and landed. On branch cs/ship-it, rhiza ship land exited 1 with 'Refused to land change set ...: its own operations rest on a stale base: <node> (field:statement) rewritten by op <op> of change set <Other>'; --json had landed=false and one model_conflicts entry (op, node, fields, base, landed_op, landed_change); the ship state file recorded the same; nothing was committed and gh pr merge was never called. rhiza ship check --model-conflict then exited 0 (JSON detail names the conflict); in another repo, after rhiza set first --rebase it exited 1 ('the recorded model conflict is repaired'), and with no conflict recorded it exited 1. Minor: its human line with a PR recorded reads 'PR #7 at : open from cs/ship-it' instead of naming the conflict.

QA by hand with the binary built at 668f5cf08 in a scratch repo where the accepted change set's own update of first rests on a base the landed change set Other rewrote: rhiza check only warned (exit 0); rhiza ship gate --model-conflict exited 1 with 'Gate failed: the change set's own operations rest on a stale base: <node> (field:statement) rewritten by op ... Restate them on the landed version (rhiza set <ref> --rebase).' and --json model_conflicts naming op, node, fields, base, landed op and change set; rhiza ship check (fake gh: PR #7 green) exited 1 with detail 'failed: 1 operation(s) of the change set rest on a stale base: ...' and recorded the conflict in .git/rhiza/ship/<cs>.json. After rhiza set first --rebase --field 'statement=Theirs and ours', ship gate --model-conflict passed (exit 0, no gate set) and ship check --model-conflict exited 1. Scoped go test ./internal/api -run 'TestShipCheck|TestShipGate|TestShipLand' ok.

QA with the binary built at 668f5cf08: rhiza workflow describe ship-change shows pr-green on.fail -> pr-model-conflict-triage (rhiza ship check --model-conflict) on.pass -> pr-model-conflict-fix; gate-land on.fail -> gate-model-conflict-triage on.pass -> model-conflict-fix; land on.fail -> land-triage on.fail -> model-conflict-triage on.pass -> model-conflict-fix -> render-model-conflict; the fixer prompts name rhiza set <ref> --rebase, the until check and the Review: {run} trailer. The repair the prompt prescribes worked by hand: rhiza set first --rebase on the stale node made ship check --model-conflict exit 1 and ship gate --model-conflict pass. .rhiza/workflows/ship-change.toml matches the builtin apart from the pre-existing head-build steps. go test ./internal/workflow/... -run TestShipChange and go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/run-ship-model-conflict-fix$ ok.
